annotations.description: More than ninety percent of at least ten allocated connections are active. The pool can grow: this is not proof of configured-maximum saturation.

rules.name: JpLearningHeapWarning
rules.query: (sum by (job) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="heap",job="vocabulary-api"}) / sum by (job) (jvm_memory_max_bytes{area="heap",job="vocabulary-api"} > 0) > 0.85) and on (job) (sum by (job) (jvm_memory_max_bytes{area="heap",job="vocabulary-api"} > 0) > 0)

annotations.description: Used heap exceeds 0.85 of positive native heap maxima; this excludes native/off-heap/container memory and requires GC/max semantics acceptance.
